National Survey of Family GrowthAbout · Using this site

About this site

This site describes the National Survey of Family Growth, published by National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS), CDC. It is generated from the repository pdt-nsfg, which holds metadata built from the publisher's documentation: each variable's label, question text, codes and missing codes, and availability, with corrections and links between releases. Each fact says where it came from.

What it isn't

  • It isn't the publisher's site, and the publisher hasn't reviewed it. The publisher's own page for the dataset is https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nsfg/. Where this site and the publisher's documentation differ, the publisher's documentation is the source; the differences this repository knows of are listed as corrections.
  • It doesn't hold the data. The data come from the publisher, or from this repository's data release when the terms allow; see Getting the data.
  • It makes no analysis decisions: which answers count as agreement, which weights or cases to use, or how to recode. Those belong to the projects that use the data.

Terms of use

Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Survey of Family Growth, public-use data files. Use is subject to the NCHS Data User Agreement (https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/policy/data-user-agreement.html): the data may be used only for statistical reporting and analysis, and users must not attempt to identify any person or link the data to identifiable data.
Publisher's terms
https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/policy/data-user-agreement.html
What they say
The NCHS Data User Agreement for public-use files (also in the 2022-2023 User's Guide, pp. 4-5) restricts use to statistical reporting and analysis and forbids identifying anyone, linking to identifiable data, and research on re-identification; none of its terms concerns redistribution. NCHS documentation is a US government work in the public domain. Allen Downey reviewed this in MarriageNSFG Task 20 (2026-11-10); confirmed for this repo on 2026-11-20.

PublicDataToolkit

The library and the standard that build this site: https://github.com/AllenDowney/PublicDataToolkit. This site was generated by version 0.2.0.

Reporting an error

  • In the publisher's documentation (a wrong label, a missing code, question text that belongs to another item): open an issue at the issue tracker of the repository pdt-nsfg, with where you found it. This repository records such errors as corrections, with the evidence, and keeps the publisher's original; it also says whether the error was reported to the publisher.
  • In this repository's records (a wrong link, a code classified wrongly, a variable left out): open an issue at the issue tracker of the repository pdt-nsfg.
  • To the publisher: National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS), CDC.
